lineage: v3 synthetic/semantic audit had PASS, but subsequent re-reading of official JV-Data specification found that v3 incorrectly mapped WH change code 000 to numeric zero. v3 is therefore superseded before any real capture/model execution. No v3 result is used to justify v4.
v4_corrections: WH body-weight change 000 means no previous race, not 0 kg. It must not emit numeric body_weight_change_kg.
WH valid change codes 001-998 remain numeric with sign; 999/blank are non-numeric.

WE initial state may carry raw announcement code 00000000. No fake official timestamp is created; when that initial state comes from the latest complete 0B14 capture acquired by the prediction snapshot, its timing basis is LOCAL_ACQUISITION and feature source time equals capture time.

Existing v3 corrections remain: AV scratch/exclusion separate from historical abnormal_code, WE turf/dirt separate, CC full parse, latest complete 0B14 capture prevents withdrawn old event carry-forward.
requested_verdict: PASS only means proceed to first real Windows/JV-Link forward-capture plumbing test. It must not authorize DEV v6, VALIDATION, or OOS until real capture provenance passes Gate v4.
